input_text: Which cities have the top 5 lowest enrollment number for students in grades 1 through 12?

input_text: What is the complete address of the school with the lowest excellence rate? Indicate the Street, City, Zip and State.
evidence: Execellence Rate = NumGE1500 / NumTstTakr; complete address has Street, City, State, Zip code
input_sql: SELECT T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY CAST(T1.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / T1.NumTstTakr ASC LIMIT 1
output_sql: SELECT TOP (1) T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY CASE WHEN T1.NumTstTakr = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(T1.NumGE1500 AS FLOAT) / CAST(T1.NumTstTakr AS FLOAT) END ASC, T2.CDSCode ASC

input_text: What is the average number of test takers from Fresno schools that opened between 1/1/1980 and 12/31/1980?
evidence: between 1/1/1980 and 12/31/1980 means the year = 1980
input_sql: SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980' AND T2.County = 'Fresno'
output_sql: SELECT AVG(CAST(T1.NumTstTakr AS FLOAT)) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE YEAR(T2.OpenDate) = 1980 AND T2.County = 'Fresno'

input_text: Which county reported the most number of school closure in the 1980s with school wonership code belonging to Youth Authority Facilities (CEA)?
evidence: Youth Authority Facilities (CEA) refers to SOC = 11; 1980s = years between 1980 and 1989
input_sql: SELECT County FROM schools WHERE strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989' AND StatusType = 'Closed' AND SOC = 11 GROUP BY County ORDER BY COUNT(School) DESC LIMIT 1
output_sql: SELECT TOP 1 County FROM schools WHERE DATEPART(year, TRY_CONVERT(date, ClosedDate)) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989 AND StatusType = 'Closed' AND TRY_CAST(LEFT(SOC, PATINDEX('%[^0-9.-]%', SOC + 'z') - 1) AS INT) = 11 GROUP BY County ORDER BY COUNT(School) DESC, MAX(County) DESC

input_text: Calculate the average number of oxygen atoms in single-bonded molecules.

input_sql: SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) FROM (SELECT T1.molecule_id, COUNT(T1.element) AS oxygen_count FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id  WHERE T2.bond_type = '-' AND T1.element = 'o'  GROUP BY T1.molecule_id) AS oxygen_counts
output_sql: SELECT AVG(CAST(oxygen_count AS FLOAT)) FROM (SELECT T1.molecule_id, COUNT(T1.element) AS oxygen_count FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '-' AND T1.element = 'o' GROUP BY T1.molecule_id) AS oxygen_counts

input_text: On average how many carcinogenic molecules are single bonded?

output_sql: SELECT AVG(CAST(single_bond_count AS FLOAT)) FROM (SELECT T3.molecule_id, COUNT(T1.bond_type) AS single_bond_count FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T3.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '-' AND T3.label = '+' GROUP BY T3.molecule_id) AS subquery

input_text: Please list top two bonds that happened with the molecule TR006 in alphabetical order.

input_sql: SELECT T2.forename, T2.surname FROM pitStops AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 on T1.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T2.nationality = 'German' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.dob) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1985' GROUP BY T2.forename, T2.surname ORDER BY AVG(T1.duration) LIMIT 3
output_sql: SELECT TOP 3 T2.forename, T2.surname FROM pitStops AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T2.nationality = 'German' AND YEAR(T2.dob) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1985 GROUP BY T2.forename, T2.surname ORDER BY AVG(T1.milliseconds)

input_text: Which constructor scored most points from Monaco Grand Prix between 1980 and 2010? List the score, name and nationality of this team.

input_text: Among all the lap records set on various circuits, what is the time for the fastest one?
input_sql: SELECT time FROM lapTimes ORDER BY (CASE WHEN INSTR(time, ':') <> INSTR(SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, ':') + 1), ':') + INSTR(time, ':') THEN CAST(SUBSTR(time, 1, INSTR(time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600 ELSE 0 END) + (CAST(SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, ':') - 2 * (INSTR(time, ':') = INSTR(SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, ':') + 1), ':') + INSTR(time, ':')), INSTR(time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60) + (CAST(SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, ':') + 1, INSTR(time, '.') - INSTR(time, ':') - 1) AS REAL)) + (CAST(SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000) ASC LIMIT 1
output_sql: SELECT TOP (1) time FROM lapTimes ORDER BY (CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(':', time) <> (CHARINDEX(':', SUBSTRING(time, CHARINDEX(':', time) + 1, LEN(time))) + CHARINDEX(':', time)) THEN TRY_CAST(LEFT(SUBSTRING(time, 1, CHARINDEX(':', time) - 1), PATINDEX('%[^0-9.+-]%', SUBSTRING(time, 1, CHARINDEX(':', time) - 1) + 'z') - 1) AS FLOAT) * 3600 ELSE 0 END) + (TRY_CAST(LEFT(SUBSTRING(time, CHARINDEX(':', time) - 2 * CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(':', time) = (CHARINDEX(':', SUBSTRING(time, CHARINDEX(':', time) + 1, LEN(time))) + CHARINDEX(':', time)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CHARINDEX(':', time) - 1), PATINDEX('%[^0-9.+-]%', SUBSTRING(time, CHARINDEX(':', time) - 2 * CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(':', time) = (CHARINDEX(':', SUBSTRING(time, CHARINDEX(':', time) + 1, LEN(time))) + CHARINDEX(':', time)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CHARINDEX(':', time) - 1) + 'z') - 1) AS FLOAT) * 60) + (TRY_CAST(LEFT(SUBSTRING(time, CHARINDEX(':', time) + 1, CHARINDEX('.', time) - CHARINDEX(':', time) - 1), PATINDEX('%[^0-9.+-]%', SUBSTRING(time, CHARINDEX(':', time) + 1, CHARINDEX('.', time) - CHARINDEX(':', time) - 1) + 'z') - 1) AS FLOAT)) + (TRY_CAST(LEFT(SUBSTRING(time, CHARINDEX('.', time) + 1, LEN(time)), PATINDEX('%[^0-9.+-]%', SUBSTRING(time, CHARINDEX('.', time) + 1, LEN(time)) + 'z') - 1) AS FLOAT) / 1000) ASC;

input_text: Which top 20 driver created the shortest lap time ever record in a Formula_1 race? Please give them full names.
evidence: shortest lap time refers to MIN(time); the time format for the shortest lap time is 'MM:SS.mmm' or 'M:SS.mmm'; full name of the driver refers to forename, surname
input_sql: WITH lap_times_in_seconds AS (SELECT driverId, (CASE WHEN SUBSTR(time, 1, INSTR(time, ':') - 1) <> '' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(time, 1, INSTR(time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, ':') + 1, INSTR(time, '.') - INSTR(time, ':') - 1) <> '' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, ':') + 1, INSTR(time, '.') - INSTR(time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, '.') + 1) <> '' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000 ELSE 0 END) AS time_in_seconds FROM lapTimes) SELECT T2.forename, T2.surname, T1.driverId FROM (SELECT driverId, MIN(time_in_seconds) AS min_time_in_seconds FROM lap_times_in_seconds GROUP BY driverId) AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId ORDER BY T1.min_time_in_seconds ASC LIMIT 20
output_sql: WITH lap_times_in_seconds AS (SELECT driverId, (CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(':', time) > 0 THEN COALESCE(TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(time, 1, CHARINDEX(':', time) - 1) AS FLOAT), 0) * 60 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(':', time) > 0 AND CHARINDEX('.', time) > CHARINDEX(':', time) THEN COALESCE(TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(time, CHARINDEX(':', time) + 1, CHARINDEX('.', time) - CHARINDEX(':', time) - 1) AS FLOAT), 0) ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('.', time) > 0 THEN COALESCE(TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(time, CHARINDEX('.', time) + 1, LEN(time)) AS FLOAT), 0) / 1000 ELSE 0 END) AS time_in_seconds FROM lapTimes) SELECT TOP 20 T2.forename, T2.surname, T1.driverId FROM (SELECT driverId, MIN(time_in_seconds) AS min_time_in_seconds FROM lap_times_in_seconds GROUP BY driverId) AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId ORDER BY T1.min_time_in_seconds ASC
